name: Tushar Tibude

description: Senior front-end engineer with 10+ years of experience in scalable architecture and modern web application development.

about.paragraph1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience crafting high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and modern frontend technologies. I've led UI engineering efforts, designed scalable architectures, and delivered end-to-end solutions for organizations like NetApp, TrilioVault, and Capitalmind. I'm passionate about leveraging AI tools like Claude and OpenAI to accelerate development and create innovative solutions.
about.paragraph2: My core strengths lie in architecting micro-frontend systems, driving component library development, and performance best practices. I thrive in cross-functional environments, collaborate effectively with product and design teams, and take pride in building clean, maintainable, and scalable codebases. I'm deeply passionate about user-centric development, progressive enhancement, AI-driven development methodologies, and pushing the boundaries of what frontend engineering can do.
